claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: Photos show brand panel text 'YAMAHA Professional' and 'YAMAHA PortaSound', but no power-on, no sound, no key-press test is shown, so functional 'quality/good' cannot be judged.
Photos 0 and 2 clearly show 'YAMAHA' branding on the panel and near the keys; no Casio markings appear anywhere.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have non-functional electronics
risks.proof: A clip or photo of the keyboard powered on, display lit, and a key being pressed with audible sound

risks.risk: Some keys may be stuck, broken, or unresponsive
risks.proof: A video panning across all keys being pressed in sequence
risks.if_unproven: priced as having full key-row defects

risks.risk: Missing power adapter/cord needed to operate the unit
risks.proof: A photo of the adapter/cord included in the sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit-only, adapter not included

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage on the back/underside or battery compartment corrosion
risks.proof: Photos of the back panel, underside, and open battery compartment

risks.risk: Seller's contradictory brand claim ('Yamaha' then 'Casio') suggests possible listing mix-up or copy-paste from another ad
risks.proof: A fresh, unwatermarked photo set from the seller matching this exact unit, plus a clear statement reconciling the brand
risks.if_unproven: treated as an unreliable/inconsistent listing; price anchored strictly to witness-confirmed Yamaha identity, not seller's text

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on with keys pressed to confirm sound and display function
Close-up photos of the back, underside, and battery compartment
Photo confirming presence or absence of the power adapter/cord
Clarification from seller on the brand discrepancy (Yamaha vs Casio) with matching proof
response.reason: The witness confirms a used Yamaha keyboard with visible branding, so it can be priced at worst case (no accessories, unverified function); the seller's claim of 'Casio' is contradicted by the photos and treated as unreliable text, not as changing the item's identity.
